summary: Conduit is a chat server implementation built on the Matrix protocol. It enables you to run your own communication infrastructure for federated messaging.
goodFor: It suits self-hosters looking for a lightweight Matrix-compatible server option written in Rust.
watchOut: As an alternative implementation of the Matrix specification, it may lack feature parity with the reference server and carries inherent protocol maturity risks.
deployNotes: You will typically need to place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and configure persistent storage for message history.
